name: AGENTOS_CONTROLLER

role_display.ongoing_rule: Current status and control-plane records identify the persistent role as AgentOS Controller; Bootstrap is reserved for first-run discovery and setup.
role_display.history_rule: Older accepted Controller state may omit the display fields and remains readable; newly compiled state always writes them.

storage_rule: Controller state is stored under the bound control-plane root and is never written into the product root by default. An in-project control plane requires an explicit owner opt-in.
purpose: A persistent project-level control plane that starts and reconciles campaigns while keeping deterministic state transitions separate from judgment.

controller_agent.wake_rule: Wake on every active campaign handoff, liveness observation, failure finding, policy amendment, or boundary change; ask the owner only when the typed boundary requires an owner decision.

controller_runtime.consequential_transition_rule: No external action is complete until a project-bound adapter performs it and returns a readback bound to the exact project, controller, policy, campaign, event, action, and external identity.
controller_runtime.persistent_state: Compare-and-swap protected state with an append-only event head and readback receipts.

supervisor.loop_rule: Hold one supervisor lease, observe current control-plane records, mint one deterministic bounded goal, route safe work, retain exact failures, and reconcile again without an outside prompt.
supervisor.hard_boundary_rule: Stop the dependent outcome on protected authority, identity, evidence, credential, destructive, external, or unresolved owner-intent boundaries.
supervisor.soft_boundary_rule: Send changed scope or operating choices to campaign Orchestrator review while unrelated safe work continues.
supervisor.puzzle_rule: Route one repairable engineering puzzle through campaign custody, then require Auditor and Controller rechecks.
supervisor.session_rule: Campaign roles remain observable through durable local sessions, heartbeats, source-bound commands, and readbacks.

campaign_boundary.successor_rule: Orient the next Campaign Orchestrator only after Auditor release clearance; do not start the next campaign before accepted-live closure.

external_adapters.rule: Model, session, worktree, repository, provider, deployment, rollback, live-audit, and browser capabilities enter through typed project-bound adapters.
